body: LOW SOFT INLAND HILLS linking the sleeping-head landscape to the aqueduct/bridges. Two overlapping low gently rolling ridge silhouettes, broad shallow valley in center to leave landmarks visible, modest more rounded hill at left and a slightly higher shoulder right. Distant pale graphite contours, very sparse fine stratum hatching and occasional tiny low ground cover, NO trees taller than a tiny shrub. No cliffs. Entire ridge belt reaches both horizontal edges at SAME elevation with matching slope for seamless repetition. Transparent sky above continuous irregular top contour, opaque light paper terrain below to bottom, no island-like cutout bottom.

name: 18_laderas_rocosas.png
body: MID-DISTANCE ROCKY SLOPES linking old stone bridges to seaside lighthouse. Layered low limestone terraces and gently eroded sloping rock shelves, a broad saddle opening in middle for bridge landmark, a few fine fissures and small roots. More detailed than far hills but quieter than playable terrain. Broad landform belt spanning edge to edge, low profile not a towering mountain or cave. Same height and tangent at left/right endpoints for seamless horizontal repetition. Transparent sky above top contour, opaque warm paper land extending to bottom, no floating island lower contour.

No large wave: existing lighthouse-wave remains a separate layer. Avoid busy detail, unified almost horizontal low profile with matched left/right height and tangent for seamless horizontal repetition. Transparent above low shoreline silhouette, opaque pale paper interiors and base to bottom. No horizon skyline: this is coastal connective foreground of the distant panorama.
